summary: This Form 8-K reports a routine debt capital markets transaction: AES Corp. completed an offering of $600M 5.200% Senior Notes due 2029 and $400M 5.750% Senior Notes due 2033 under its existing shelf registration statement. The offering was underwritten by J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, Citi, Goldman Sachs, and SMBC Nikko. Net proceeds will be used to repay existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary financing event with no special-situation characteristics like a change of control, tender offer, or restructuring.
